name: Film — prerendered photoreal loops
cli: Blender -b --factory-startup --python run.py -- SPEC.json (--stills DIR | --still FILE | --anim DIR [--frames A-B] | --build-sequence DIR) [--variant V] [--camera C] [--engine cycles|eevee] [--res WxH] [--samples N] [--no-post] | --layers-still PREFIX --frame N [--full] | --layers-anim DIR [--frames A-B] [--tiles …] [--tile-samples k=n,…]

protocol.progress: lines 'PROGRESS {json}': stage fetch|build|still|sample|frame|layer, done, of, eta_s (layers: + tile)
protocol.result: final line 'RESULT {json}': ok, outputs, timings | ok=false, error

encode: python3 -I dsfilm/encode.py FRAMES_DIR OUT_BASE  ->  OUT_BASE.mov (HEVC main10 hvc1) + OUT_BASE-preview.mp4
licence_of_assets: CC0 only (Poly Haven, ambientCG); logged in <cache>/LICENSES.tsv
layers: light layers (docs/film-layers.md): run.py --layers-anim DIR -> python3 -I dsfilm/layerpack.py pack DIR OUT -> OUT/layers.mov (3x2 pow4 tiles, HEVC Main10) + OUT/layers.json; job.py loop --variants layers does both
